slides.label: Verse 1
lines: Everyday I’ll sing of Your steadfast
love and mercy
The exceeding riches of Your grace
is beyond compare
The depth of Your love
is unsearchable

slides.label: Verse 2
lines: Oh Lord great is Your faithfulness
Oh Lord great is Your faithfulness

slides.label: Verse 3
lines: Everyday You are my portion
Everyday my cup overflows
Jesus, the glory of my strength
In Your favour my horn is exalted

slides.label: Verse 4
lines: Everyday You load me with benefits
Everyday new mercies I see
Oh Lord, Your testimonies are sure
I rejoice in You the God of my salvation

slides.label: Verse 5
lines: Everyday!

slides.label: Verse 6
